app_description: A local-first Remix 3 SPA that stays useful when the network does not.
footer_built_with: Built local-first with Remix 3, Bun, Vite, and Remix CSS mixins.
not_found_copy: This path is not on the map. Head back to the starting point.
home_title: Keep moving when the signal stops.
home_intro: Wayfinder keeps your essential plans close at hand. Your app shell and checklist stay available on the quiet side of the coverage map.
home_route_title: A tiny plan that lives on this device.
home_route_copy: Check off each item. The list is saved to local storage, so a refresh or lost connection will not erase your progress.
checklist_complete: All packed. This plan is ready to travel offline.
checklist_remaining_one: 1 item left before you head out.
checklist_remaining_other: {count} items left before you head out.
map_accessible_title: A stylized route through hills to a campsite
offline_title: The network is optional after the first visit.
offline_intro: This starter ships as an installable progressive web app. Once the service worker has prepared the offline cache, the interface and routes continue to work without a connection.
offline_feature_shell_copy: Vite builds fingerprinted assets and Workbox precaches them during service worker installation.
offline_feature_routes_copy: Navigation requests fall back to the cached index document, then Remix resolves the route in the browser.
offline_feature_progress_copy: Checklist state lives in local storage, so it remains available through refreshes and network changes.
offline_test_copy: Load the production preview once, switch DevTools to Offline, then refresh either route.
